description: This Java class is a command handler that facilitates creating a holiday in the system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes a command, and delegates the creation logic to the HolidayWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateHolidayCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for holidays, delegating the creation process to the HolidayWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CreateHolidayCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the HolidayWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create a holiday by delegating to the holiday write platform service.
